summary: For Ansible-initiated workflows, hashicorp.terraform offers API integration with Terraform Enterprise or HCP Terraform, needs no binary and includes a default execution environment; cloud.terraform offers CLI integration and needs the terraform binary in a custom EE. hashicorp.terraform is recommended.
questions: What is the difference between hashicorp.terraform and cloud.terraform?
Which Terraform collection should I use with AAP?
Does hashicorp.terraform need the terraform binary?

answer_card.title: hashicorp.terraform vs cloud.terraform
answer_card.answer_md:
| | `hashicorp.terraform` | `cloud.terraform` |
|---|---|---|
| Integration | API | CLI |
| terraform binary | not needed | must be installed |
| Execution environment | default EE included | build your own |
| Recommendation | recommended | supported |
